_comment: Russian dictionary for the FIXED animated GEOPOL shell (geopol_html/skeleton.html).
SAME DOCTRINE AS scripts/i18n/deck_i18n.js: the language is DATA, not a branch. DECK_LANG's
2-letter code selects `geopol_html/i18n/<code>.json`; a language with no file falls back to
English, and an English run never enters the localiser at all (so EN output is byte-identical).
Dropping a `de.json` next to this file is the ONLY thing needed to add German — no code change.
German is deliberately NOT shipped here: the German deck copy is reviewed elsewhere, and
inventing a second, unreviewed German source for legal-adjacent prose is how two translations
drift apart.
KEYS ARE THE EXACT ENGLISH SOURCE STRING, so a missing entry degrades to readable English
rather than to a blank or a raw key. Three separate maps because they are applied by three
different, deliberately narrow mechanisms:
strings  — replaced ONLY inside HTML TEXT NODES of the skeleton (never across CSS/JS).
canvas   — replaced ONLY as complete quoted STRING LITERALS inside the <script> block.
fallback — read by author_geopol.py for the DETERMINISTIC scene content (model-free path).
NOT TRANSLATED, ON PURPOSE:
· Service categories are proper nouns in this product's vocabulary and stay English exactly
as enrich.py's LANG_RU block instructs: SASE, ZTNA, WAF, NGFW, SSE, SOC, Managed Firewall,
Managed DDoS protection, Managed SOC, SD-WAN, DPI/NDR.
· Frameworks / IDs: MITRE ATT&CK, CISA, KEV, BSI, NIS2, DMARC, CVE ids, C2, SCM, ASN/AS,
IPs, ports, hostnames, protocol names (VPN, TLS, RDP, SSH, SMB, SNMP), company names.
· TWO canvas literals are LOOKUP KEYS, not copy, and translating them would silently break
the scene-04 animation: 'SASE · ZTNA' is compared with === to draw the QUICK WIN badge, and
'SSE · SECURE EGRESS' is matched with indexOf('EGRESS') to draw the enclosing fabric. Same
hard rule as the severity/tier enums in scripts/i18n/i18n.py — never translate a key.
_untranslated_note: Source strings that stay ENGLISH on purpose. build_geopol_html.js prints every text node with
no dictionary entry and ship.py FAILS THE DEPLOY on it — so a paragraph added to the skeleton
and never translated cannot ship silently. This list is the reviewed exception set: brand,
and service categories, which enrich.py's LANG_RU block explicitly forbids translating.
The <title> node is here because build_geopol_html.js rewrites the whole <title> from the
localised default (see `strings`), so translating the placeholder text would be dead work.
